container_metadata_screen.interpretation: Container-level metadata only; no frame content, identity, location or event labels were published.

eligible_use: qualitative CCTV and 3D scene/topology matching after human frame review
operator-action and equipment-state sequence annotation after provenance review
visual timing cross-check against an independently attested station-side trace
training replay of observed visual cues without exposing the source media
ineligible_use: quantitative pressure, temperature, flow or inventory fitting
consequence-distance validation or automatic safety-limit generation
full-loop vehicle-fueling validation or SAGA effectiveness claims
required_before_stronger_claims: custodian attestation of provenance, recording clock and operational context
human review of representative frames with generic equipment/zone labels
reacquisition or repair of the 9 incomplete containers
authorized time alignment to a synchronized station-side trace
independent holdout policy before any model tuning or validation use
claim_boundary: The local collection contains useful visual operational evidence, but metadata alone cannot establish what event occurred, where it occurred, or whether a process variable changed. Keep the raw media private and separate from quantitative validation datasets.
